# ArSee · Open-Source IEC 60870-5-101/103/104 Protocol Tester & Analyzer

Free Apache-2.0 Windows IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 60870-5-104 tester and evidence analyzer. Inspect original TX/RX frames, supported values/events, findings and native PDF reports. Not a production SCADA or certified IEC conformance suite.

## Published builds
- Latest public stable v3.6.20: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/tag/v3.6.20
- Stable Windows installer: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/download/v3.6.20/ArSee-v3.6.20-setup-win-x64.exe
- Stable Windows portable ZIP: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/download/v3.6.20/ArSee-v3.6.20-win-x64.zip
- Stable SHA-256: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/download/v3.6.20/SHA256SUMS.txt
- Previous stable v3.6.19: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/tag/v3.6.19
- Archived public prerelease v3.6.20-rc.1: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/tag/v3.6.20-rc.1
- Exact-source stable Package/provenance: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/actions/runs/44898156357
- Native Windows previous-release updater and branded installer migration FAT: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/actions/runs/44897646916
- Historical IEC-101 draft #145 is closed superseded; physical RTU/SCADA FAT remains separately unverified.

## Stable v3.6.20 improvements (published 21 November 2026)
- Operator-tested IEC-101 first-Connect automatic GI, active A/B ownership and safe COM recovery, without replaying ambiguous transmitted commands.
- Compact, readable Redundancy timeline; Enter immediately on first opening Connection Setup triggers Connect; Disconnect keeps Setup open.
- Events Include/Exclude filters persist across new sessions; compact INT16 values show numeric raw/engineering scaling without decoder label.
- Full source-bound Windows package, installer upgrade FAT, CodeQL, SBOM and provenance passed. Independent multi-vendor physical FAT remains separate.

## Historical stable v3.6.19 improvements (published 21 November 2026)
- IEC-101 Class-1 queue evidence uses verified FC10→FC8 and ACD=1 to mark pending data; ACD=0 removes the cue from subsequent events. Not a per-event FIFO-origin/age bit.
- IEC-101 field widths persist across IEC-103/104 mode changes; compact dialogs and clearer feedback.
- Authentic v3.6.17/v3.6.18 folder migration and installed updater tests passed. User data stays in `%LOCALAPPDATA%/ARIEC60870`.

## Historical stable v3.6.18 improvements (published 20 November 2026)
- User-facing Windows application is ArSee.exe with one ArSee Start Menu shortcut; new installs default to Programs/ArSee.
- Safe manual in-place upgrade from v3.6.17 removes the known old ARIEC60870 executable/shortcuts, preserves existing user data and may retain the previous installation directory for rollback/uninstall compatibility.
- New downloadable installer, portable ZIP and SPDX SBOM use ArSee-v3.6.18 names. The already-published v3.6.17 installer is immutable; its updater cannot automatically discover the renamed v3.6.18 asset, so one manual installer upgrade is required.
- Windows x64 source, genuine legacy migration, updater FAT, WPF, packaging and provenance passed at the exact released source; this is not physical SICAM/SCADA FAT.

## Historical stable v3.6.17 improvements (published 19 November 2026)
- FC10 and FC11 Events tooltips are concise: “Class 1 Data Polling” and “Class 2 Data Polling” for verified observed IEC-101 polls.
- Latest Event auto-follow button highlights only when following, including scroll and selection changes.
- Bilingual Help Center and IEC 60870 handbook, Signal Map grid-first editor and Windows installer/ZIP.
- Historical source-bound stable Package: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/actions/runs/44540333243

## Earlier stable v3.6.16 improvements
- Grid-first Signal Map with find/filter and optional resizable engineering inspector.
- Excel-like multi-cell paste, Fill Down and Undo/Redo; configured Factor/TwoPoint parameters are preserved.
- Physical RTU/SCADA interoperability and station-specific TI11 counts-to-MVar FAT are not certified.

## Evidence boundary
An addressed link response is not always an accepted application ASDU. GI is not proof every point was received. HOLD pins only the displayed viewport, not recording. Unverified IEC-101 balanced mode or physical multi-vendor FAT must not be claimed.
